strengths.note: Heavily involved; the team plays through them.
strengths.coach: You were everywhere. Teammates looked for you because they trust you.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Found the back of the net. Never gets old, does it?

weaknesses.detail: Tackles attempted: 0 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 2 or less)
weaknesses.title: Defensive work rate
tips: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
weaknesses.coach: Need more bite without the ball. Defending is everybody's job.

weaknesses.detail: 26 passes but no key passes - plenty of the ball, little going forward
weaknesses.title: Playing forward
tips: Look forward first. Check the striker's run and the gap between the lines before the sideways pass.
Switch play when they shift across. Quickest way to find space is usually on the far side.
Arrive late at the edge of the box for cutbacks. That's where midfield chances come from.
weaknesses.coach: Plenty of the ball, but not much going forward. Let's hurt 'em with it.

push.title: D 1-1 vs Toot DatÄss | You: 7.8 (above average MID)
push.body:
Good stuff, BellyTb1. A 7.8 against Toot DatÄss. Not fireworks, but a nice warm campfire.

DID WELL
+ 26 passes. You were the busiest person on the pitch. I'm tired just watching.
+ A goal against Toot DatÄss, your 2nd straight match scoring. That ball had your name on it from the moment you set your feet.
+ 2 shots on target: +0.1. Like finding a twenty in last winter's coat.
+ 1-1 with Toot DatÄss. Not the ending we wanted, but the story's still going.

WORK ON
- No tackles attempted. Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
- No key passes from 26 passes. Arrive late at the edge of the box for cutbacks. That's where midfield chances come from.
- Pass accuracy: 77%. Halfway up the mountain. The view from 87%+ is something else.

This week's homework: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.

Pick one thing from that list and own it next match. Just one. - Coach Lasso

players.name: PhogsToffees

strengths.title: Getting shots off
strengths.coach: You kept finding ways to get shots off. Can't score 'em if you don't take 'em.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Made chances for your teammates. Unselfish football is the best kind.

weaknesses.detail: Shots on target: 33% (bottom quarter of forwards is 60% or less)
weaknesses.title: Shot selection
tips: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.
Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.
Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.
weaknesses.coach: A few too many shots went wide or over. Better looks, better results.

weaknesses.detail: 20/32 passes (62%) - below the ~72% point where extra passes start costing rating
weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

weaknesses.detail: Won 0 of 7 tackles (0%) - diving in; each miss leaves a runner free
weaknesses.title: Tackle timing
tips: Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.
Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.
Stay on your feet. Slide only when you're certain of the ball and there's somebody behind you.
weaknesses.coach: Diving in a bit too eager. Patience in the tackle.

players.headline: Solid forward performance (7.2, above average for the position) - best at getting shots off, chance creation; work on shot selection, forcing passes.

coach.closer: I believe in you. More importantly, I need you to believe in you.

push.title: D 1-1 vs Toot DatÄss | You: 7.2 (above average FOR)
push.body:
Solid shift, PhogsToffees. A 7.2 clears the bar for a forward, and solid is the soil good things grow in.

DID WELL
+ 3 shots at Toot DatÄss's goal. Fortune favors the folks who shoot.
+ 1 assist. Chances like that are gifts. You were Santa out there.
+ You found BellyTb1 and BellyTb1 found the net. That's chemistry you can't buy at the store.
+ 1-1 with Toot DatÄss. A draw is a win that hasn't figured itself out yet.

WORK ON
- 1 of 3 shots on target. Tell you what: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.
- 62% passing (20 of 32). Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.
- Won 0 of 7 tackles. Show them down the line, toward the touchline and away from goal, then strike.

Back-garden drill: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.

I believe in you. More importantly, I need you to believe in you. - Coach Lasso
